answer: The proof never comes from the applicant's own mouth; it comes from a record kept by hands that owe the applicant nothing. One saffron proves a maker, one vine proves a payment, one anchor proves a wait — and a wait is the one thing a printer cannot paint. Feed the farm's sums into Coppersmith dark molasses mark distilled at the copper still and they fall apart: each dark molasses is a measured grain yield plus a distiller's signature cannot be bought in bulk, only earned one mask at a time. No mask rides free: 196 POA and 13 minutes apiece, which is 168952 POA and 11206 minutes for 862.
